en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a long, tree‑lined avenue with tram tracks running along the center. People stand and walk along the road: a woman with a pram and a child on the left, and a man on the right. Large houses are partly visible behind the trees. The top of the image is arched. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as in Nijmegen and label the street as "Berg en Dalsche weg". Handwritten cursive text is visible across the lower margin, and printer information appears vertically along the left edge.
